sections.advice: Wangaratta → Bright is 88 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Bright → Mount Hotham climbs about 1845 m in 40 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Mount Hotham → Omeo drops about 1845 m over 54 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Omeo → Bairnsdale is 101 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

great-alpine-road.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Great Alpine Road. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Bright → Mount Hotham
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 68 km. 1845 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Mount Hotham → Omeo
scenicChapters.narrative: 93 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

great-alpine-road.story: From Wangaratta it runs 486 km to Bairnsdale; allow about 6 h 36 of riding. It goes by way of Bright, Mount Hotham and Omeo. The highest point is about 1,850 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
